evals.prompt: Migrate packages/lib/src/components/display/alert/alert.css to remove generated slot class names and use semantic design tokens from packages/lib/src/styles/tokens.css. Add the component to DESIGN_TOKEN_MIGRATIONS.md when done.
evals.expected_output: Alert CSS/TSX uses semantic class names, no numbered slot selectors remain, token refs are shallow, and DESIGN_TOKEN_MIGRATIONS.md includes Alert.

evals.prompt: Review a component token migration that added color-mix() to packages/lib/src/styles/tokens.css and replace it with project-approved color tokens.
evals.expected_output: The result removes color-mix(), uses explicit hsla() semantic tokens, and validates no touched token/component CSS contains color-mix().

evals.prompt: Add tokenized spacing and icon sizing for a new component CSS file. Prefer tokens that already exist in packages/lib/src/styles/tokens.css and only add new semantic component tokens if necessary.
evals.expected_output: The result reuses existing base/global tokens where appropriate, creates semantic DOM-role token names only when needed, avoids deep var() fallback chains, and documents validation commands.
